_readme: Companion copy of the producing training run's artifact/meta.json — the file the export zip does NOT contain.

The delivered zip (t033-encoder-int8-mlmodelc.zip) holds exactly one top-level directory, t033-encoder-int8.mlmodelc; the label sets and the fitted calibration temperature live only in the run's artifact/meta.json, so the runtime ships this unchanged subset of that file alongside the vocabulary table.
Keys _readme/_provenance are documentation for humans; IntentEncoderManifestResource decodes only the keys below.

_provenance.task: T-036 (re-pinned to the T-036 v0 artifact by T-036-repin)
_provenance.artifact_digest_note: artifact_digest above is the sha256 of the producing run's model.pt, recorded there in full; only the project's 12-character hex reference is committed (same convention as the checkpoint reference in ModelCatalog).
_provenance.backbone: cartesinus/multilingual_minilm-amazon-massive-intent (revision prefix 08dc4816), MIT — see tools/train-intent/src/encoder_tokenizer_export.py for the full attribution
